claims.location: source name, characteristics[genotype], factor value[genotype], comment[label] rows 1-18
claims.value: WT/KO in jacalin-enriched fractions, WT/Hetero in flow-through proteome
claims.evidence: Deposited Proteome Discoverer XLSX headers explicitly associate F29/F30 channels 126-128 with WT and 129-131 with KO; F31 channels 126-128 with WT and 129-131 with Hetero. Exact basename-matched RAWs identify two jacalin runs and one flow-through run.

PRIDE sample protocol explicitly describes Golph3 WT/KO mouse liver; deposited search result protein descriptions are Mus musculus OX=10090. PRIDE structured organism dropdown conflicts and was not followed.

claims.location: comment[instrument], cleavage, acquisition, tolerances and modifications rows 1-18
claims.value: Orbitrap Fusion TMT6 DDA, trypsin, Sequest HT settings
claims.evidence: PRIDE methods state Orbitrap Fusion top-10 DDA, trypsin, 6ppm precursor and 20mmu fragment search tolerances, carbamidomethyl/oxidation; result headers and PRIDE sample protocol identify TMT6plex labeling.

limitations: The two jacalin RAW files encode original fractions 10 and 11_12; build assigns ordinal fraction identifiers 1 and 2 within this deposited subset, while filenames retain original labels.
The PRIDE structured organism dropdown is human, but sample protocol and deposited mouse protein IDs support Mus musculus.
The source does not identify exact animal IDs shared across jacalin and flow-through workflows; biological replicate numbering is within each genotype/workflow, not a claim of cross-workflow pairing.
HexNAc variable search settings are glyco-specific and omitted from common technical table to avoid falsely applying them to flow-through proteome.
